description.value: The Horticulture Gardens are a botanical and landscaped garden space located on the Thompson Rivers University campus in Kamloops. Listed under TRU's conference centre facilities, the gardens serve both as a campus green space and an event venue. Touring cyclists passing through Kamloops may find it a pleasant short detour while visiting the university area.
